name: Fighter Bonus Points
description: The bonus points a newly bought fighter rolls for each stat come out bigger: always the most, never nothing, or with odds you set.
author: KSFA

settings.label: Bonus points

options.label: Never nothing (stock odds for the rest)

settings.help: Each stat of a fighter you buy rolls a bonus of 0, 5, 10, 15 or 20% of its grade's level cap, which raises that stat's cap until the first limit break. At stock half of all rolls give nothing. 'Never nothing' takes the 0 out and keeps the other odds as they were; 'Always the biggest' gives every stat 20%.

settings.label: Odds of no bonus
settings.help: Stock 50. The five odds are shares: each one's chance is its number out of the five added together, so they do not have to add up to 100. 0 means never; all five at 0 means no bonus at all.

settings.label: Odds of 20%
settings.help: Stock 5. 20% is the biggest bonus the game can give: the five sizes are built into the game, only their odds are data.

patches.description: No stat rolls a bonus of nothing
patches.sql: UPDATE master_const_int SET value = 0 WHERE id = 'BODY_BONUS_0';

patches.description: Every stat rolls the biggest bonus
patches.sql: UPDATE master_const_int SET value = CASE id WHEN 'BODY_BONUS_20' THEN 100 ELSE 0 END WHERE id IN ('BODY_BONUS_0', 'BODY_BONUS_5', 'BODY_BONUS_10', 'BODY_BONUS_15', 'BODY_BONUS_20');

UPDATE master_const_int SET value = CASE id WHEN 'BODY_BONUS_0' THEN {{w0}} WHEN 'BODY_BONUS_5' THEN {{w5}} WHEN 'BODY_BONUS_10' THEN {{w10}} WHEN 'BODY_BONUS_15' THEN {{w15}} ELSE {{w20}} END WHERE id IN ('BODY_BONUS_0', 'BODY_BONUS_5', 'BODY_BONUS_10', 'BODY_BONUS_15', 'BODY_BONUS_20');
